policy: Faster source for positive player ppm. Bandlimited polyphase resampling of the entire dry file before room convolution, with the original background on the receiver clock. Round the command boundary to the nearest output sample. External reference is silent. Self uses the entire projected file on the receiver clock. Muted controls keep the command. The separate bathroom probe holds the mic fixed and projects the Opus cue reference onto a clock with a specified accumulated offset at cue start. No long recording or physical clock measurement.
